title: Charisma and humour
learning_outcomes: Explain warmth and attention in the context of charisma and humour.
Compare and distinguish humour in the context of charisma and humour.
Apply engaging stories in the context of charisma and humour.
Evaluate and justify decisions about authenticity in the context of charisma and humour.

lessons.title: Warmth and attention
lessons.outcome: Explain warmth and attention in the context of charisma and humour.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving warmth and attention; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Create an annotated explanation with a concrete example and a counterexample. Connect the result to introduction and feedback.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain warmth and attention from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of warmth and attention; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Humour
lessons.outcome: Compare and distinguish humour in the context of charisma and humour.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving humour; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Compare two cases or approaches using explicit criteria; identify an important limitation. Connect the result to introduction and feedback.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain humour from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of humour; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Engaging stories
lessons.outcome: Apply engaging stories in the context of charisma and humour.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving engaging stories; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Work through a new case or simulation; document assumptions and steps. Connect the result to introduction and feedback.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain engaging stories from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of engaging stories; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Authenticity
lessons.outcome: Evaluate and justify decisions about authenticity in the context of charisma and humour.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving authenticity; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Analyse an unfamiliar case; defend a choice, identify uncertainty and revise after feedback. Connect the result to introduction and feedback.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain authenticity from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of authenticity; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

criteria.criterion: Accurate explanation of warmth and attention; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of humour; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of engaging stories; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of authenticity; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

assessment.threshold: All mapped criteria at level 2; no averaging away missing criteria. Level 3 requires independent novel application, delayed reassessment and appropriate review.
assessment.alternate_evidence: Equivalent accessible written, oral, visual, simulated or supervised evidence; no personal disclosure required.

safety.notes: Respect consent, privacy and applicable rules; source and subject review before publication.
